discovery_method: Gap analysis of the existing catalog against common project entry points: browser and unit test frameworks, API clients and mock servers, editors and shells, Windows and cross-platform package managers, CI workflow tooling, Kubernetes operations and policy tools, secrets management, supply-chain and runtime security, observability and BI, plus written engineering conventions. Each candidate was checked against existing entries by URL, name, and GitHub project identity before inclusion; duplicates and already-covered projects were dropped.
verification_limits: Metadata and reachability only. GitHub entries: REST repository endpoint, HTTP 200, recorded repository id, detected license, topics, and last push. Documentation entries: one page fetch. No README/source review, release or maintenance audit, licensing opinion, security assessment, compatibility test, pricing review, or adoption assessment. No package installed or executed.
